name: boot
description: Boot the disc and reach the title screen: the executable loads OPENSEG for the opening movie (DIGIMON.MOV, about 7,000 frames, not skippable), then runTitleMenu reloads OPENSEG and OPEN_runTitleScreen shows the logo and waits for START. Checkpoints once OPENSEG is loaded and at the title's 'press start' state. Every step waits on game state.

steps.comment: PLAYER_PROFILES allocated by initPlayerData, at the address probes.lua hashes
OPENSEG loaded (its first word, the overlay id 8): the opening movie's overlay
OPEN_TITLE_STATE 6: the logo's animation is over and 'PRESS START' blinks (open_title.c states 6-7)
